notes.title: Raven - The Goblin Hunter's Demo is Released!
notes.notes:
Hi Our Friends and Players,

Raven's Demo is Released! Very Good Players can complete our Demo in 20 Minutes. Medium Level Players will spend around 30 Minutes. It is time to test yourself :)

Challenge one of the Goblin King's Lords and solve his naughty puzzles. Go to deep down of dungeons, fight against nasty goblins and save your little sister's bracelet!
